what: Head-to-head: two players each command a Bopl blob-king's army in a synchronous blob-skirmish round (3 blob clashes, best of 3). 9 Kings itself stays single-player; the versus mode is the mod's own LAN mode run inside both players' 9 Kings.

messages.carries: army layout, hp, positions each tick

meltyWiring.contract: melty's native multiplayer: at start empty {localappdata}/BoplKings/melty.log and read join= from melty.properties; empty = host on 0.0.0.0 (Melty's relay carries friends to it), write 'Melty join address: <ip>:<port>' to melty.log; address present = join, write 'Melty joined: <address>' or 'Melty join failed: <why>'

relay: melty's own relay carries joiners to the host's 0.0.0.0 listener — no port forwarding, ever

rows.starts: join= empty: listens on 0.0.0.0, port from BOPLKINGS_PORT
